scope: aroma descriptor and food chemistry
disposition: Fennel describes the aroma attributed to a detected volatile. A pure seed contrast was outside the meat preparation study.

scope: aqueous plant extract and citrus nematode
disposition: Larval mortality, egg hatching and citrus plant responses leave mammalian movement outside scope.

scope: seed-extract mediated metal nanoparticles
disposition: The animal comparisons are toxicology of the synthesized products. The extract and nanoparticles have separate roles and no resting-tremor outcome is established.

scope: essential oil acute rat toxicity
disposition: Regulator reports toxicity-associated tremor at the highest dose. Original published paper's behavioral methods remain open.

scope: different botanical oil and shared volatiles
disposition: Ocimum selloi oil contains similar volatiles and at high doses is associated with hypoactivity and ataxia. This was not fennel oil or a tremor test.

scope: fennel oil components and mites
disposition: Pest mortality has no mammalian endpoint.

scope: rat embryo tissue culture
disposition: Fennel essential oil reduced cell viability without a measured clinical or motor outcome.

scope: tarragon oil and induced seizures
disposition: Shared compounds are a chemistry lead. Tarragon and seizure outcomes do not resolve the frozen exposure or symptom.

scope: crown rot in fennel
disposition: The exposure is a fungus affecting the crop, with no ingestion or symptom assay.

scope: fennel oil in cake and a human seizure
disposition: A pharmacovigilance report describes an acute seizure in epilepsy, with dose and resting tremor unavailable.

scope: herbal compounds in liver cell line
disposition: Cell steatosis measures do not establish tremor or ordinary fennel ingestion.

scope: contaminated fresh fennel and cattle tremors
disposition: Feed nitrate and rumen nitrate support a contaminant-associated syndrome. Plant parts were market scraps. No culinary seed or Parkinson model.

scope: fresh leaf oil and healthy mouse behavior
disposition: Behavior and acute toxicity reported. No separate tremor count or seed comparison.

scope: review of fennel preparations
disposition: Use as reference trail. Underlying reports stay separate.

scope: four-herb formula and guinea pig intestine
disposition: Fennel is genuinely present, but tissue contractions and formula-level safety do not isolate a seed or resting-tremor effect.

scope: human traditional uses survey
disposition: Fennel is cited in the survey. The available abstract does not specify a fennel tremor use. Keep separate from the local livestock survey.

scope: fennel seed extract in lead-challenged mice
disposition: Cortical morphology and gene expression were measured. No resting-tremor endpoint was reported.

scope: roasting and fennel fruit volatile chemistry
disposition: Direct prepared-food analytics with no symptom. Full processing and sample tables remain open.

scope: essential-oil seizure review
disposition: Follow cited cases and deduplicate the fennel case already read.

scope: whole-crushed seed pellets in healthy mice
disposition: The reported home and open-field activity signs differ. Resting tremor and toasting were not studied.

scope: Apiaceae oils and grain beetles
disposition: Pest endpoints do not inform a mammalian symptom.

scope: combined Eupatorium and fennel extract
disposition: Repeated oral formula toxicology reports general signs and exposure-specific biochemical outcomes. No fennel arm or separately scored tremor.

scope: five-herb digestive product
disposition: Higher doses changed organ measures. Whole-formula general behavior observations have no separate fennel or tremor result.

scope: alpha-phellandrene review
disposition: Citation context for a shared compound. No independent frozen exposure or symptom result.

scope: isolated estragole and pain models
disposition: Open-field crossings and rearing at a specific dose show no clear group difference. Tremor was not the endpoint.

scope: culinary spice review in neurological disorders
disposition: Narrative source lead. No independent toasted fennel resting-tremor comparison.

scope: isolated fenchone and acute rat toxicity
disposition: Toxicity Table 1 marks combined convulsions/tremors absent in both conditions. Healthy animals and isolated constituent leave the frozen effect open.

scope: fennel composition and safety review
disposition: Citation source only. Match the original preparation and outcome before using a direction.

scope: isolated anethole in rotenone rats
disposition: Motor assessment is rotarod and stride length. Resting tremor is only a background disease feature.

scope: fennel extract and rotational motion sickness
disposition: The rotational model measures motion sickness and activity or neurotransmitters. It does not measure Parkinson resting tremor.

scope: cold plasma treatment of spices
disposition: Food physicochemistry and microbiology. No toast preparation or clinical endpoint.

scope: roasted chicken with fennel-like anethole aroma
disposition: Aromatic compounds are measured in chicken components. The fennel-odor label and mention of spices do not isolate a named seed exposure or symptom.

scope: fennel seed extract and isolated arteries
disposition: Mesenteric vasorelaxation assay has no separately observed motor or clinical comparison.

scope: fennel analytical arm and coriander in vivo arm
disposition: Fennel appears in chemical screening. Coriander was selected for the in vivo neurotoxicity experiment.

scope: oral methanolic extract under acute and repeat protocols
disposition: No deaths were reported. The abstract does not give an itemized tremor observation.

scope: fennel seed within heated composite rapeseed oil
disposition: Fennel held in a mixture across preparation changes. Chemical and sensory results give no separate fennel or symptom contrast.

scope: fennel compounds and computational target
disposition: Docking work has no measured ingestion or motor outcome.

scope: fennel in a hydroalcoholic multicomponent formulation
disposition: General anxiolytic, stress and toxicology outcomes were reported for the combination. No separate fennel tremor effect.

scope: fennel and clove essential oils in insect models
disposition: Insecticidal and selectivity endpoints do not measure mammalian symptoms.
